title: Softmax and temperature
ask: A model scores four next words for “The capital of France is …”. Softmax turns the scores into shares. It divides each score by a temperature T first.

blocks.prompt: T goes from 1 to 2. What happens to the share of Paris?
blocks.why: Say why, in one line, before you lock in.

blocks.label: Temperature T
blocks.note: A high T makes the shares more equal.

blocks.text: The top word, **{p.0.id}**, has a share of {p.0.value:3}. Move T near 0.1. What does softmax become then? Why?
